newsitem.title: PAPUA NEW GUINEA: PNG army chiefs sets 48-hour deadline for PM to quit.
newsitem.headline: PNG army chiefs sets 48-hour deadline for PM to quit.

text.p: Papua New Guinea's army chief called on Monday for the resignation of Prime Minister Sir Julius Chan within 48 hours because of his plans to use foreign mercenaries on Bougainville.

"If the PM and his deputy and minister for defence do not step down within 48 hours then I will plea to Papua New Guineans to join hands to force them to resign," Brigadier General Jerry Singirok said in a statement given to journalists at a news conference.
